{{Quote|Aye, General&hellip; But what good will that do us if our ''air support'' can't get close enough to stop the ''harvesters''?|[[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]], to [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]|<ref name="Seeds" />}}
The '''scythe harvester''' was a tracked vehicle used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Scythe_harvester_2.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A scythe harvester taking down two LAAT/i gunships]]
The scythe harvester was armed with six [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], in addition to a powerful [[laser scythe]]. The laser scythe cleared a path for the tracked vehicle and was able to take down [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] gunships.

==History==
Two scythe harvesters were deployed during a [[Battle on an unidentified farming moon|battle]] on a [[Unidentified farming moon|farming moon]] in orbit of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. During the battle, the scythe harvesters razed the local [[Farm/Legends|farmlands]] and destroyed several LAAT/i gunships, thus depriving [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] commanded by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]] of air support. [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] used one of the [[Unidentified reptavian species|native]] [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavians]] to reach the roof of one of the scythe harvesters, which he commandeered and turned against the other.
